sections.subhead: Beyond Themes and Plugins — WordPress Built Around How Your Business Actually Works

body.html: Custom WordPress development is writing new code — plugins, custom post types, Gutenberg blocks and API integrations — so WordPress does what off-the-shelf themes and plugins cannot. Teknoppy's Kochi team builds and documents this code to core WordPress standards, so it stays stable through updates.
Service: custom plugins, post types, Gutenberg blocks, API integrations | Team: in-house, Vyttila, Kochi | Handover: code repo + documentation

sections.h2: Custom WordPress Development Cost in Kochi

paragraphs.html: Custom WordPress pricing depends on functional scope: small custom plugins typically range from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 35,000, while bespoke booking workflows, CRM integrations, and member dashboards range from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 1,20,000+. For complete website builds, see our WordPress Development Company in Kochi page. Request a Quote for a scoped proposal.

items.q: What counts as custom WordPress development versus a regular build?
items.a: A regular build configures an existing theme and plugins. Custom WordPress development means writing new code — a plugin, custom post type, Gutenberg blocks or API integration — for business logic no existing tool handles, such as seasonal room pricing or syncing enquiries to your CRM. It is built to WordPress standards so it survives updates.

items.q: How much does custom WordPress development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Typical small plugins range from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 35,000, while custom booking workflows, CRM integrations, and member dashboards range from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 depending on requirements. We provide a fixed quote after requirements mapping.
You do. 100% of the custom source code, documentation, and Git repositories are handed over to your team upon launch with no proprietary lock-in.

items.q: Should I build this in WordPress or as a custom web application?
items.a: If your project centers on content, service presentation, and a few custom workflows, WordPress is ideal. If the core product is the software itself (multi-tenant SaaS, complex web portal), see our Web Application Development services.
items.aHtml: If your project centers on content, service presentation, and a few custom workflows, WordPress is ideal. If the core product is the software itself (multi-tenant SaaS, complex web portal), see our Web Application Development services.

items.q: Can you integrate WordPress with software we already use?
items.a: Yes. Our WordPress API integration work regularly connects WordPress to CRMs, accounting tools, booking platforms, and other business software through secure APIs.

items.q: Will custom code break when WordPress updates?
items.a: Not if it's built correctly. We follow WordPress core coding standards, hooks, and filter architectures specifically so custom features remain stable through core and plugin updates.
